extracted_concepts.name: Multiplication
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Operation of repeated addition; core to area, factor pairs, and fraction understanding.

extracted_concepts.name: Division
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Inverse of multiplication; used to split quantities into equal groups.

extracted_concepts.name: Fractions
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A quantity formed by 1 part of a whole divided into b equal parts, written a/b.

extracted_concepts.name: Decimals
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Extension of fractions to base-ten representation; part of the core number chain.

extracted_concepts.name: Area
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Measure of the surface enclosed by a shape; related to multiplication and addition.

extracted_concepts.name: Perimeter
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Total distance around the boundary of a two-dimensional figure.

extracted_concepts.name: Place Value
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The value of a digit based on its position in a number; generalizes to multi-digit numbers.

extracted_concepts.name: Rounding
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Approximating a whole number to the nearest ten, hundred, or thousand using place value.

extracted_concepts.name: Addition
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Combining quantities; one of the four basic operations.

extracted_concepts.name: Subtraction
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Finding the difference between quantities; inverse of addition.

extracted_concepts.name: Number Line
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A visual representation of numbers where fractions can be placed at specific points.

extracted_concepts.name: Fraction Equivalence
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Two fractions are equivalent if a/b = (a×n)/(b×n) for any non-zero n.

extracted_concepts.name: Factor Pairs
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Pairs of numbers that multiply to give a given number; found for numbers 1-100.

extracted_concepts.name: Multistep Word Problems
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Word problems requiring more than one operation to solve.

extracted_concepts.name: Scaled Graphs
aliases: scaled picture graphs and bar graphs
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Graphs where each picture or bar represents more than one unit.

extracted_concepts.name: Angles
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Figures formed by two rays sharing a common endpoint; classified by measure.

extracted_concepts.name: Parallel Lines
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Lines in a plane that never intersect; used to classify two-dimensional figures.

extracted_concepts.name: Perpendicular Lines
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Lines that intersect at a right angle (90 degrees).

extracted_concepts.name: Line Segments
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A part of a line bounded by two distinct endpoints.

extracted_concepts.name: Rays
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A part of a line that starts at a point and extends infinitely in one direction.

extracted_concepts.name: Liquid Volume
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Measurement of the amount of liquid a container can hold.

extracted_concepts.name: Mass
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Measurement of the amount of matter in an object.

extracted_concepts.name: Time Telling
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Reading and writing time to the nearest minute on an analog or digital clock.

extracted_concepts.name: Partitioning Shapes
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Dividing shapes into parts with equal areas to understand fractions.

extracted_concepts.name: Multi-digit Numbers
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Numbers with more than one digit; place value understanding generalizes to these.

extracted_concepts.name: Like Denominators
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Fractions that share the same denominator, enabling direct addition.

extracted_concepts.name: Arithmetic Patterns
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Identifiable patterns in sequences involving the four operations.

extracted_concepts.name: Multiplication as Comparison
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Interpreting a multiplication equation as a comparison of quantities.

extracted_concepts.name: Four Operations
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The set of addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division.

extracted_concepts.name: Measurement Units
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Standard units for measuring length, mass, volume, and time with known relative sizes.
